name: United Blood Nation
description: The United Blood Nation (UBN), also known as the East Coast Bloods, is a prison-originated confederation of street gang sets founded on July 16, 1993 at Rikers Island by Omar 'OG Mack' Portee and Leonard 'OG Dead Eye' McKenzie to protect African American inmates from the Latin Kings and Ñetas. Originally predominantly African American, membership has since expanded to include Asians, Caucasians, and Hispanics, with law enforcement estimating over 7,000 members active across Eastern Seaboard states. Operating as the East Coast affiliate of the California-based Bloods, UBN's criminal activities include drug trafficking, robbery, extortion, and prostitution, with major subsets including Nine Trey Gangsters and Sex Money Murder.
